title: The Last Crown Anew
author: Theo Nakamura
blurb: Lena Zhou, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
